verdict.rationale: Gazebo officially documents building directly against its own libraries: gz-math, sdformat, gz-transport (pub/sub, services, discovery) and a gz-fuel-tools C++ client library can be used in your own C++ applications. It also supports developing custom gz-sim plugins and consuming the libraries as ROS vendor packages. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond C++ (e.g. Python bindings), API reference/tutorial depth for the SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
